text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iraq's vice-president meets Indonsian leader in Rome.
- Head of the foreign office of the Baath Party Saad Qasem Hammoudi in Spain to attend conference on embargo on Iraq.
- President Saddam Hussein hails the World Food Summit in Rome.
- Two Pakistani firms to bring 41,800 tonnes of rice to Iraq.
- Foreign ministry says Iraq has no Kuwaiti prisoner.
